# trim_connections_to_unique_regions { #mofography.helper.trim_connections_to_unique_regions }

```python
helper.trim_connections_to_unique_regions(connections, unique_regions)
```

Keep connections with at least one endpoint label in *unique_regions*.

For unit-cell pore graphs / plotting: edges touching at least one region
with voxels inside the central cell (``unique_regions`` from periodic seg).
Periodic edges with one endpoint outside the cell are retained.



## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

connections : list
    Each entry ``c`` has ``c[0]`` = pair of region label ints.
unique_regions : array-like of int
    Labels from ``do_periodic_segmentation*`` output.



## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

list
    Filtered connections. If *unique_regions* is empty, returns a shallow
    copy of *connections* unchanged.
